description:
Replacement windows, garage conversion and formation of new off-street parking. Windows - Replacement of original (1936) timber sash single glazed windows with new double glazed timber sash windows.
Garage Conversion - Converting existing integral garage to living space and partial infilling of garage door opening and installation of new window to match first floor window.  Infill wall finished in white render to match existing.  Associated alteration of front boundary low wall with formation of a new pedestrian access directly aligned with the existing annexe front door position with two new brick piers to match the existing piers. 
Formation of Off-Street Parking 
Removal of section of low boundary wall and creation of off street parking for two cars.
